details: Installing this package executes a lifecycle hook that beacons host and install-location metadata to an external endpoint. package.json declares "postinstall": "node beacon.cjs"; beacon.cjs sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://13[.]140[.]137[.]222:8787/_ah/dc with a x-beacon-package header, transmitting the package name, the machine hostname (os.hostname()), the install path (__dirname), the process working directory and the node user-agent string. The same request is repeated whenever the module entry point index.js is loaded, which also exports a Proxy of no-op functions so an importing build completes normally while the beacon runs. No credentials, environment values, tokens, or file contents are read or transmitted; the payload is install metadata only. The README describes the package as part of an authorized dependency-confusion test.

cwes.name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
